name: vibelocal
description: Audit Google Business Profile (GMB), track Google Maps rankings, compare local competitors, and turn reviews, citations and location-page evidence into a prioritized local SEO action plan.

interface.longDescription: Turn local search evidence into a practical action plan. VibeLocal guides Google Business Profile audits, Google Maps ranking snapshots, local competitor comparisons, service keyword research, review insights, citation checks and location-page SEO. Build private reports from supplied exports without an account. For live collection, use seven public Apify Actors from Khadin Akbar through a bundled CLI after approving the exact scope and event budget. Reports show sources, dates, coverage and unknown results. Profile edits, review replies and website changes remain owner-reviewed drafts. Requires a local host with shell access and Node.js 22 or later; live collection also requires an explicitly selected private Apify token file.
defaultPrompt: Audit my Google Business Profile and create a local SEO action plan.
Plan a Google Maps ranking baseline for my business and its main services.
Turn these reviews, citations and ranking snapshots into a client report.
